heading: CHIP IN NOW
text: Adam Cervera is a dedicated advocate for children, families, and academic excellence. A proud graduate of Broward County Public Schools, Adam attended local elementary and middle schools and graduated from J.P. Taravella High School. He brings both professional expertise and personal passion to his role on the School Board, where he works to promote high standards, strong parental involvement, and a student-first approach to education.

heading: CHIP IN NOW
text: Professionally, Adam is an accomplished attorney where he practices business litigation and represents clients in administrative proceedings. He earned his Bachelor’s degree in Political Science from the University of Central Florida and his Juris Doctor from Florida International University College of Law.

text: A strong believer in family and community, Adam is actively involved in youth sports and serves as a team parent. He sees firsthand how discipline, teamwork, and accountability help shape confident and resilient young people—values he champions in the classroom as well.

text: Adam is married to Teressa Maria Cervera, and together they are raising their three children: Austin (9), Autumn (7), and Anthony (6 months). Their family is grounded in service, faith, and a shared belief in the power of education to transform lives.

heading: Pricing Plans
text: While at FIU Law, Adam was deeply involved in child advocacy work through the Juvenile Justice and Education Advocacy Clinics. He represented special needs students and at-risk youth across South Florida, earning multiple awards for his service, including the CALI Excellence for the Future Award and FIU Law’s Excellence in Service Award. He later served on the South Florida Regional Board of Read to a Child, a national nonprofit focused on literacy and mentoring in under-resourced schools.
